overview_description.description:
Dot is an AI-powered data assistant that democratizes data analysis by enabling users to interact with their data warehouses through natural language conversations. By integrating seamlessly with existing data stacks—including platforms like Snowflake, Redshift, Looker, and dbt—Dot automates ad-hoc data requests, allowing data teams to concentrate on high-impact tasks. Users can access Dot via Slack, Microsoft Teams, or a native web application, making data insights readily available across the organization. ￼

Founded in 2021 and backed by Y Combinator, Dot is committed to enhancing data accessibility and fostering data-driven decision-making within enterprises. ￼

By leveraging advanced AI capabilities, Dot ensures accurate data interpretation and analysis, empowering business stakeholders to obtain insights swiftly and efficiently. ￼

product.name: Dot AI Data Analyst
product.description: An AI-powered data assistant that answers data questions, performs root cause analysis, and generates business reports from connected data sources.

product.name: BigQuery Integration
product.description: Integration that enables Dot to answer questions based on data stored in Google BigQuery data warehouse.

product.name: Databricks SQL Integration
product.description: Integration allowing Dot to answer questions using data from Databricks SQL data lakehouse platform.

product.name: dbt Integration
product.description: Integration that enables Dot to leverage metrics and semantic models defined in the dbt Semantic Layer for consistent data answers.

product.name: DuckDB Integration
product.description: Integration enabling Dot to answer questions based on data stored in DuckDB analytical database.

product.name: Metabase Integration
product.description: Integration that allows Dot to replicate business logic from Metabase dashboards to answer data questions.
